A special place for the first evening is truly special
Aug 2026 • Couples
Last night was our first date, so it was a very special evening for both of us. And it is hard to think of a more beautiful and suitable space than Hoi An Sense for this occasion.

From the moment you step in, the warm wood, soft lighting, and the water feature in the center of the restaurant created an atmosphere that was both elegant and intimate. The exquisitely prepared dishes, the carefully selected wine list, and the attentive yet discreet service style made the experience complete.

We felt completely comfortable throughout the evening. Hoi An Sense provided a space truly worthy of such a special evening for our first date.

Thank you to you and the entire team for the very thoughtful reception. It was a wonderful evening that both of us will always remember with beautiful feelings.

Don't be trapped, they just want to rip you off !!
Apr 2024 • Business
Be invited for dinner here with my business partner. But all they have is a shiny exterior, opposite with that is the very average food with imperceptible flavor, some of seem staleness and indeed 3 people have got diarrhea after dinner including myself.
The most disappointing experience was the dishonesty of an order taker. We pre-ordered the food for dinner as an a la carte but required combining them in a set menu with a strong emphasis that the set menu must only be enough for an average adult. I have asked for her consulting on the chosen list to make sure I had not ordered too much. 
When we finished 6th plate and almost full, they served 7th plate which was a huge lobster that everyone cannot handle so I realized that instead of giving an honest guidance, they just want to sell the food as much as they can. That overwhelming food has ruined my dinner essentially and made me look like a starving bloke.

Definitely not come back and not recommend.

Beautiful restaurant with a refined setting
Mar 2024 • Friends
Very nice place with a very stylish welcome! When you arrive you will pass a large fish pond with a typical Vietnamese music orchestra! Frequented by the local bourgeoisie, the cuisine is good, without frills! It is not very modern but nicely presented to tastes made for all palates.
Large wine list.
Don’t come too late because after 8:30 p.m. the room is almost empty, the orchestra has finished a long time ago and you can hear the disturbing noises from tidying up at the end of the evening! Come around 7:00 p.m. to enjoy the atmosphere!
